name: University of Salford

sources.title: WHAT IS A CREDIBILITY INTERVIEW? (University of Salford Tier 4 credibility interview leaflet PDF)
topics: Your career aspirations, including your post-study plans and reasons for these plans
Information about your course of study, including modules and course content
Information about the funding of your studies in the UK
Your understanding of the rules and regulations for your Tier 4 visa
Your living arrangements, including how close this will be to the University
Details about the University’s location in the UK
Your personal life and your family history
quotes: HOW DO YOUR STUDIES FIT INTO YOUR CAREER PLANS?
What do I want to do after studying my course?
How does this course fit with my career objectives?
Will the course I want to study enable me to compete within the working environment?
WHY DID YOU CHOOSE THE UNIVERSITY OF SALFORD?
HOW WILL YOU FUND YOUR STUDIES?
WHAT TIES DO YOU HAVE TO YOUR HOME COUNTRY?
WHERE DO YOU PLAN TO LIVE?
YOU HAVE PREVIOUSLY OVERSTAYED. WHY WAS THIS THE CASE?
sources.notes: PDF extracted locally with pypdf. UKVI interviews 'All interviews are conducted in English and normally via video link.' Guidance also says you 'may be asked to provide information about any gaps in your employment or study history', to explain source and sustainability of funds, hours/rules of Tier 4, proximity of accommodation to campus, and previous refusals. If refused on credibility, email Salford-CAS@salford.ac.uk for transcript request.
